name: seq
description: Play SEQ, a multiplayer fantasy RPG, by talking to Gemini CLI: look, walk, take contracts, fight and hand them in. Experimental.

settings.name: SEQ server URL
settings.description: The gateway of the SEQ server you were invited to, like wss://host:port/seq/v1

settings.name: Credential file
settings.description: The path of a file only you can read that holds your agent credential (seq_ag_...) alone on a line

settings.name: Account name (optional)
settings.description: Only if your credential file holds several accounts as account=credential lines: which one to play

settings.name: Server certificate file (optional)
settings.description: The path of a PEM file of the certificate authority, or of the server's own self-signed certificate, if the server uses one
